window: 2023-01-01 <= M15 close < 2025-01-01 Europe/Moscow; actual late starts retained

A1.name: ONE_BAR_EXIT
A1.rule: On the first observed complete post-entry M15 only, if LONG Close <= original PriorHigh or SHORT Close >= original PriorLow, queue exit at next observed M15 Open if still open. No later A1 check.

A2.name: TWO_BAR_EXIT
A2.window_source: User clarification before any variant results, 2026-10-12
A2.rule: Only among the first FOUR observed complete post-entry M15 candles, two successive closes on the wrong side of original breakout level queue exit at next observed Open. A correct-side close resets the count. After candle four disable the check permanently, including an uncompleted run. A trigger on candle four executes at candle five Open. Never combined with A1; no window search.

A3.name: BREAKOUT_BODY_QUALITY
A3.rule: Permit raw T3 signal only if range > 0, absolute body >= 0.50 * range, and signal * (Close - Open) > 0. Equality at 50% passes; doji fails.

A4.name: H1_ADX_RISING
A4.rule: Latest completed original H1 ADX > immediately preceding completed original H1 ADX. Strict inequality. Missing predecessor fails.

A5.name: H1_EMA_SLOPE_STRENGTHENING
A5.rule: LONG: current positive H1 slope > previous completed H1 slope. SHORT: abs(current negative H1 slope) > abs(previous completed H1 slope). Original T3 supplies current sign. Missing predecessor fails.

A6.name: H1_ATR_EXPANSION
A6.rule: Latest completed H1 ATR/ATRMean > previous completed H1 ATR/ATRMean. Original ATR > ATRMean still applies. Strict inequality; missing predecessor fails.

A7.name: M15_ATR_RISING
A7.rule: ATR of completed M15 signal candle > ATR of immediately preceding observed completed M15 candle. Strict inequality; missing predecessor fails.

execution.entry: Original signal Close is a historical oracle, not verified executable Close fill.
execution.h1: Original daily ordinal blocks of four consecutive 15-minute closes. Incomplete or gapped blocks skipped without repacking; state indicators explicitly cross days.
execution.stop: Original continuous initial Stop and trailing, checked before current-bar trailing, new ratchet active next observed bar. No tick-grid correction.
execution.pending_exit: At next observed bar Open: adverse protective Stop gap has priority, otherwise queued market exit fills at that Open before any later intrabar event. Never inspect future intrabar Stop to choose a better fill.
execution.gaps: First available real next Open, including session gaps. Two consecutive A2 observations may cross a gap; no synthetic candle, reset, or price. No terminal forced liquidation.
execution.labels: Original Stop exits preserve historical exit_time = candle close label; exact intrabar time unknown. New exits use known next Open time, with both bar endpoints recorded. Original same-close re-entry retained.
execution.costs: Zero deducted expenses; Gross R = direction*(exit-entry)/abs(entry-initial_stop). No C1, fee, slippage, or funding calculation.

analysis_only.trend_winner: Original closed gross_R >= 2R; fixed diagnostic definition, never an entry/exit input.
analysis_only.winner_matching: Match version/instrument/direction/exact entry_time. Report skipped, changed, open and retained, and newly introduced entry losses separately. Does not claim causal counterfactual equivalence.
analysis_only.concentration: Top 5/10 positive Gross R divided by total positive Gross R, plus removal sensitivity.
analysis_only.calendar: By exit label in Moscow, include every available calendar month for each instrument and pooled scope; zero months included. R sums are bookkeeping, not real portfolio returns.
analysis_only.drawdown: Closed-trade cumulative R, sorted exit_time/instrument/trade_id with initial equity zero. No capital allocation or mark-to-market portfolio model.
analysis_only.november: Report 2024, November 2024, and 2024 excluding November using the same replay; removal is post-hoc sensitivity only.

prohibited: Combinations, numeric search, Optimization, 2025+ OHLC, new Robustness/WF/TRUE OOS, production, broker endpoints, merge or auto-merge.
